_help: Home mosaic order (owner only; visitors can't change it). mode: "listed" = the ids below in this exact order (anything new or not listed follows at the end), "mixed" = project, photo, project, photo (ignores the list), "random" = a new shuffle every visit. Ids come from data/projects.json and data/art.json. To try layouts: open index.html?shuffle, reload until you like one, then copy the order the browser console prints into this file. See README, Home order.
